definitions.explanation: A person who inherits or is entitled to inherit property, rights, or title from a deceased person. A legal term frequently used in everyday discussions about inheritance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相続人|そうぞくにん}だ。
{法定相続人|ほうていそうぞくにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{配偶者|はいぐうしゃ}→配偶者：07430_haiguusha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧です。
examples.english: The legal heirs are the spouse and children.

examples.japanese: {相続人|そうぞくにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{遺産|いさん}→遺産：14405_isan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When there are multiple heirs, they need to discuss how to divide the estate.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧ (inheritance/succession) and ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person). Used in both legal and everyday contexts when discussing inheritance matters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法定|ほうてい}{相続人|そうぞくにん}: legal heir (defined by law)
- {相続人|そうぞくにん}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: all heirs
- {相続人|そうぞくにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確定|かくてい}→確定：13707_kakutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to determine the heirs
- {相続人|そうぞくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧: heir's rights

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧: inheritance/succession
- ⟦{遺産|いさん}→遺産：14405_isan⟧: estate/inheritance (the property itself)
- ⟦{遺言|ゆいごん}→遺言：10896_yuigon⟧: will/testament
- {被相続人|ひそうぞくにん}: the deceased (from whom property is inherited)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Inheritance law in Japan follows a defined order: spouse, then children, then parents, then siblings. The {法定相続人|ほうていそうぞくにん} (legal heirs) system is a frequent topic in financial planning and tax discussions.
